scope: Focused maintenance correctness follow-up to 553f312; controlled-state cloud regressions only. No new online or emulator gameplay claim.
changes: Once a staged policy has activated, postponement/unsafe/stale/deadline/cancellation/ownership invalidation restores the prior policy, advances the controller generation, cancels owned work and clears queued/prefetched work.
The stale-state observation and watchdog invalidation paths use the same rollback behavior.

Quiescence counts two consecutive fresh idle public game ticks after arrival/drain; busy publications reset the streak, duplicate revisions in one tick cannot advance it, and skipped public ticks break it.
Pending checkpoint writes cannot reactivate a canceled/postponed or expired update. Terminal cancellation/postponement is preserved.
